review.acceptance_walk:
I ran the bench "review-l4-starts-sessions" (daemon 49150, UI 2750) from my worktree at b306883. I used the stand-in only and started it fresh 4 times. The walk JSONs, with every step's screen text, are in /tmp/frbench/review-l4-starts-sessions/walk1..7.json. Screenshots of walk 6 are in /tmp/frbench/review-l4-starts-sessions/kept-steps/. The later --fresh starts wiped the steps/ folder of walks 1-5, so their screen texts survive only in the JSONs.

Walk 1-2 (201), bench-api with --api-key refused. I pressed Start in the UI on "Field notes". The session stopped at once to wait. More > Sessions showed "1 session / Nothing finished. / 16:33 · under a minute · Stopped to wait for a Claude credential · CHF 0.00", and GET /projects/:id/sessions returned count 1. I saved an ok key through POST /setup/anthropic. The work then went on by itself. The tab showed 2 sessions; the newer row read "... · goes on with your session of 16:33". I restarted the daemon (restart-daemon.mjs) and both rows stayed, still with count 2. PASS.

Walk 3 (202/205/206/213), FORERUNNER_BENCH_ASK. Two questions cards appeared. Under Send answers: "The task goes on with your answers; it runs at your next Start." Go ahead without: "...; it runs at your next Start." I answered one card through the UI form. Nothing started. While a session of the project ran, the other card read "...; it joins the running session if it fits." With start_by_itself on (settings.set plus its yes), it read "...; a session starts for it by itself." The answer then started a session. Its page's first line was "Started by itself when work was ready (this project's setting), with a budget of CHF 5.00." and its row said "started by itself when work was ready". Once both tasks were done, the Answered lines were 'Answers saved in the decision record; "X" is done.'. The Sessions row went "2 needed you · 2 still need you", then "2 needed you · 1 still needs you". The session page badge still read "Ended: 1 task needs you". PASS.

Walk 4 (207/208). The header read 'The coder works on "Write the quote list in quotes.md" (0 of 2 done)', the same words as the bar. Last result read "Running now: Open the session". I crashed the daemon with restart-daemon --hard. Inbox > Updates showed the Update with Continue and "Opens Start with the rest of your last session and the CHF 5.00 left of its budget." The press opened the Start dialog ("What is left of that session's budget is filled in: it goes on with that, never more."). Its Start posted continues, both tasks finished, and the Continue then went away. PASS.

Walk 5 (209). While Club site ran, Start on Bird notes was queued. Its header read 'Starts after the session on "Club site"' with Cancel. There was no Start session button at 1280 or at 375 px, and no sideways scroll. A second POST /sessions answered queued with the same startId and 'A session of Bird notes already starts after the session on "Club site".'. Cancel dropped the start and Start session came back. PASS. My 203 try on the bench did not exercise the case: the CHF 0.03 session ended before Make ready. I verified 203 through its real-daemon case instead.

Walk 6 (208), bench-api with --api-key limited and a slow critic. The Overview at 1280 and 375 px had 2 Cancels: the bar's and Working now's, so exactly one outside the bar. The header line read "Waiting until 16:44 (your API key's limit), then it goes on" with no action, and there was no sideways scroll. After the reset, the session page's Current task read 'The critic checks "Write the legend in legend.md"' and the header read 'The critic checks "..." (0 of 1 done)'. PASS.

Walk 7 (207 sibling), on the stand-in. Crash, Continue, then Stop now on the continuation. The Update then offered Continue again with the full CHF 1.00. That is blocking item 2 below.

Tests. I ran the fixer's named tests on the fix branch: all pass. I then reverted the 23 modified source files to claude/nifty-knuth-f9udt0 and kept the new tests and the two new leaf modules. All 8 new or changed real-daemon cases failed with the expected assertions: Quit-during-review/207, 201, 202, 203, 204, 208, 209 and 213. 37 runtime, commands and state unit tests failed too, among them starts-words 205/202, event-lines 206, session-list 213, the state suite's 201 case, session-join too_large and the commands limitChanged case. fixed.problem: Review blocking item 2 (L4-money-207 sibling; money rule 'never more'): after a crash, the Update kept offering Continue after a later session of the project had begun. Bench walk 7 did Continue, then Stop now on the continuation. The Update offered 'the CHF 1.00 left of its budget' again, and a second Continue started another session with all of it. Root cause, part 1: crashContinueOf (daemon/views.ts) did not check for a later session, although waitBlockOf does. Part 2: POST /sessions with `continues` gave the earlier session's cap less its own spend, and did not take off what a session that already went on with it had used.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-starts-sessions, run L4' > 'L4-money-207: once a later session of the project began, the crash Update offers no Continue, and a Continue sent after it gets only what is left'. Before the fix the Update kept its Continue. With only the Update fixed, the second Continue's cap was still the whole rest: expected 6233130, got 6243183. Also apps/ui/test/inbox.test.tsx 'the Update shows Continue with what it does; the press opens Start ...': no POST /messages/msg_crash/read happened on the press.
fixed.how: crashContinueOf offers Continue only while no non-planning session of the project has begun since the interrupted one ended. This is the same rule as waitBlockOf. POST /sessions with `continues` now takes off, from what is left, what each session that already went on with that session used (found through `plan.startedBy.continues`): its spend once it has ended, or its whole cap while it still runs. The Continue press also marks the Update read (InboxPage CrashContinue onPress). markRead keeps the row's derived action until the next read of the Inbox, so the open Start dialog stays. The fake daemon follows both rules: a later-session check in the crash Continue, and a continuesOf map used by the POST /sessions continues guard (cleared on reset). New UI case: 'once a later session of the project began the Update offers no Continue, only Mark read'. Docs: runtime.md, apps.md, the user guide, and a dated addition to the ADR 0118 L4-money-207 amendment.

notes_for_other_areas: LastSessionOutcome.pausedByYou?: NamedTask[] (session/result.ts, append-only): tasks the person paused (Pause or Stop) while the session ran them, still paused by them at its end. It is not part of needsYou. SessionRecord.pausedByYou? (session-list.ts) is optional.

The result builder 'cancelled by you' now also says the person's pause in one sentence ('You cancelled "A" and paused "B"; nothing else ran.'). NOT_NEWS matches 'You (cancelled|paused) .+?; nothing else ran.'.
stillBlocked (daemon/views.ts) skips outcome.pausedByYou tasks while isPausedByPerson. The Overview's sinceLines input skips them too.
crashContinueOf hides Continue once any non-planning session of the project was created after the interrupted one ended. Its rule matches waitBlockOf.

POST /sessions with `continues`: left = cap - spent - what sessions with plan.startedBy.continues === that id took (their spend once ended, their whole cap while working). The fake daemon keeps state.continuesOf (session id to the session it continued) for the same rule, and reset clears it.
InboxPage markRead keeps a row's derived `action` when the read route answers, until the next GET /inbox.
